mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals stronger economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 growth not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% triggers a loss of investor confidence in the labor market, causing negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 6.0% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in consumer spending (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust demand, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both proxies increase > 5% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both proxies rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects stronger supply-side activity, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative when FEDFUNDS spikes above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) and strong demand growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 3%), S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in late-cycle with those conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a healthy labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both labor indicators align.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 (indicating contraction) reduces supply chain efficiency, leading to negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative when INDPRO drops below 95.
